idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the eleventh month, Hulao again fell to the Suolu.

idiomatic: On the renchen day, General Who Campaigns South Tan Daoji was sent north on a punitive campaign, while General of the Right Dao Yanzhi fled in retreat from Huatai.

idiomatic: On the yihai day, fire broke out in the capital and spread to the north wall of the Altar of Soil and Grain.

idiomatic: Zhu Lingxiu, Inspector of Yan Province, was found guilty and executed.

idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the first month in spring of the eighth year, the commandery of Zhuya was re-established in Jiao Province.

literal: On the jiashen day of the third month, the imperial carriage heard cases at the Hall of Extended Worthies.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the third month, the Emperor heard legal cases at the Hall of Extended Worthies.

literal: An edict said: "Of late military service has flourished and state expenses have grown; stores are insufficient and the hundred administrations remain burdensome.
idiomatic: An edict said: "Of late military campaigns have multiplied and state expenditures have swollen; reserves no longer suffice and government remains overburdened.

literal: It is fitting to preserve simplicity and frugality to match actual circumstances.
idiomatic: Simplicity and restraint should be maintained to match what the times require.

literal: Inside and outside the court may jointly deliberate in detail, striving to ensure economy."
idiomatic: Within and beyond the court all should deliberate together and strive for thrift."

literal: On the jiayin day in the fourth month of summer, Ruan Wanling, Tutor to the Prince of Hengyang, was made Governor of Xiang Province.
idiomatic: On the jiayin day in the fourth month of summer, Ruan Wanling, Tutor to the Prince of Hengyang, was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

literal: On the yimao day, Xu Zunzhi, Senior Clerk of the Rear Army, was made Inspector of Yan Province.
idiomatic: On the yimao day, Xu Zunzhi, Senior Clerk of the Rear Army, was appointed Inspector of Yan Province.

literal: On the yichou day of the sixth month, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the yichou day of the sixth month, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: On the jimao day, the Jiangnan region and Jinling commandery of Yang Province were attached to Southern Xu Province, and the region north of the river was attached to Yan Province.
idiomatic: On the jimao day, the Jiangnan region and Jinling commandery in Yang Province were placed under Southern Xu Province, and the territory north of the river was placed under Yan Province.

literal: Prince of Jingling Yixuan, Inspector of Xu Province, was changed to Governor of Southern Yan Province; Ji Han, Senior Clerk of the Minister over the Masses, was made Inspector of Xu Province.
idiomatic: Prince of Jingling Yixuan, Inspector of Xu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Southern Yan Province; Ji Han, Senior Clerk of the Minister over the Masses, was appointed Inspector of Xu Province.

literal: An edict said: "Of late agriculture and sericulture have slackened; idlers who wander for food are many; fallow waste is not opened, and overseers' assessments go unheard.
idiomatic: An edict said: "Of late farming and sericulture have languished; wanderers living off others are numerous; wasteland lies unreclaimed, and supervisory duties go unreported.

literal: When drought or flood strikes for a season, exhaustion follows at once; if one does not deeply hold to the fundamental work, [9] abundance cannot be had.
idiomatic: A single season of flood or drought brings destitution; unless the fundamental work of the land is deeply upheld, [9] plenty cannot be secured.

literal: Prefects administer government in the capital region; magistrates are lords close to the people—they should ponder encouragement and instruction, guiding them with good rules.
idiomatic: Prefects govern the metropolitan districts; magistrates are masters closest to the people—they should reflect on how to encourage and instruct them, guiding them with sound policies.

literal: All should be made to exert their strength so no land is left unused; in plowing, silk culture, and planting each should give full effort.
idiomatic: All should be set to their labor so that no land lies idle; in plowing, sericulture, and planting each should give full effort.

literal: If any have exceptional diligence in the fields, at year's end list and report them upward."
idiomatic: Those with outstanding achievement in cultivation should, when the year ends, be listed by name and reported upward."

literal: Yang Province suffered drought.
idiomatic: Yang Province suffered drought.

literal: On the yisi day, attendant censors were sent to review prison cases and adjust corvée labor.
idiomatic: On the yisi day, attendant censors were dispatched to review prison cases and adjust corvée obligations.

literal: On the bingwu day, Liu Daochan, Consulting Colonel of the Left Army, was made Governor of Yong Province.
idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Liu Daochan, Consulting Colonel of the Left Army, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, Xiang Province was abolished and reincorporated into Jing Province.

idiomatic: On the yihai day in the fourth month of summer, Yin Mu, General Who Protects the Army, was made Special Grandee and Right Grandee of Splendid Virtue; Dao Yanzhi, Duke of Jianchang, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

literal: An edict said: "Yi, Liang, Jiao, and Guang—their territories are remote and far; governance should suit local conditions, yet in many places partial monopolies prevail.
idiomatic: An edict said: "Yi, Liang, Jiao, and Guang lie in distant borderlands; administration should accord with local conditions, yet in many places power is held in narrow, selfish hands.

literal: Great envoys may again be dispatched to tour and seek the people's afflictions."
idiomatic: Let great envoys again be sent forth to tour the regions and inquire into the people's hardships."

literal: The offices of General of Volley-Shooters and General of Strong Crossbows were established.
idiomatic: The posts of General of Volley-Shooters and General of Strong Crossbows were established.

idiomatic: On the renyin day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was appointed General Who Campaigns North with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes and Governor of Southern Yan Province; Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Front, became General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jing Province; Prince of Jingling Yixuan, Governor of Southern Yan Province, was made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and General of the Central Army; and Prince of Hengyang Yiji, General Who Campaigns against Barbarians, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.
